posts.post: Director, Banco do Brasil (international area director in 1997, director in 1998 per Exame; exact dates not stated)

case_links.role: Banco do Brasil director in 1998; accused over the bank's R$874 million guarantee (fiança) to Solpart for the Telebras auction; defendants argued Opportunity, Previ and Sistel backing made it acceptable. Criminal action locked by STJ in Nov 2010.
case_links.detail: Exame article opened; it also reports that the Silex improbity action (STF) was archived. Earlier text rested on a search summary.

controversies.what: Accused of 'má gestão de instituição financeira' (reckless management) over a R$874 million Banco do Brasil guarantee to Solpart for the Telebras auction (1998).
controversies.outcome: The STJ Sixth Panel ordered the criminal action locked (trancamento) in November 2010 (Exame). Exame reports the PGR found no evidence that Pedro Parente, responsible for the guarantee, committed crimes against the financial system.

controversies.what: Convicted of embezzlement (peculato) in April 2005 by the 6th Federal Criminal Court of Rio in the Marka/FonteCindam rescue case (Cacciola page).
controversies.outcome: TRF-2 upheld the first-instance convictions in 2008 and reduced the other sentences (pt.wikipedia).
